title: Electricity Access and Economic Development: Leveraging Climate Finance in Sub-Saharan Africa
Power Hungry: How AI Will Drive Energy Demand
abstract: The development and deployment of large language models like ChatGPT across the world requires expanding data centers that consume vast amounts of electricity. Using descriptive statistics and a multi-country computable general equilibrium model (IMF-ENV), we examine how AI-driven data center growth affects electricity consumption, electricity prices, and carbon emissions. Our analysis of national accounts reveals AI-producing sectors in the U.S. have grown nearly triple the rate of the private non-farm business sector, with firm-level evidence showing electricity costs for vertically integrated AI companies nearly doubled between 2019-2023. Simulating AI scenarios in the IMF-ENV model based on projected data center power consumption up to 2030, we find the AI boom will cause manageable but varying increases in energy prices and emissions depending on policies and infrastructure constraints. Under scenarios with constrained growth in renewable energy capacity and limited expansion of transmission infrastructure, U.S. electricity prices could increase by 8.6%, while U.S. and global carbon emissions would rise by 5.5% and 1.2% respectively under current policies. Our findings highlight the importance of aligning energy policies with AI development to support this technological revolution, while mitigating environmental impacts.
abstract_zh: ChatGPT等大型语言模型在全球范围的开发与部署，需要不断扩建的数据中心，而数据中心消耗大量电力。我们利用描述性统计和一个多国可计算一般均衡模型（IMF-ENV），考察了人工智能驱动的数据中心增长如何影响电力消费、电价和碳排放。我们对国民账户的分析显示，美国的人工智能生产部门增长速度几乎是私人非农商业部门的三倍；企业层面的证据显示，2019至2023年间，纵向一体化的人工智能企业的电力成本几乎翻了一番。基于数据中心到2030年的预计用电量，我们在IMF-ENV模型中模拟了人工智能情景，发现人工智能热潮将引起能源价格和排放的可控但存在差异的上升，具体取决于政策和基础设施约束。在可再生能源装机增长受限且输电基础设施扩张有限的情景下，美国电价可能上涨8.6%；在现行政策下，美国和全球碳排放将分别上升5.5%和1.2%。我们的研究结果强调，能源政策必须与人工智能发展相协调，以支持这场技术革命，同时减轻环境影响。

title: Macroeconomic Impacts of China’s Energy Transition
abstract: Solar and wind power account for a growing share of electricity generation in China and now dominate new capacity additions. As the power system transitions toward renewable generation, greater flexibility will be required to maintain system stability. This paper uses a computable general equilibrium model to assess the macroeconomic implications of this transition. Model results indicate a modest increase in electricity prices in the near-term, followed by sustained declines as renewable shares rise, particularly when variability is managed through battery storage rather than coal-fired backup generation. While the transition requires substantial adjustments in electricity supply and investment, it raises GDP in the long run and strengthens energy security. Battery-based flexibility outperforms continued reliance on coal across multiple dimensions, even when accounting for rising electricity demand from emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence. However, this transition pathway also increases the risk of stranded assets in the coal power sector.
abstract_zh: 太阳能和风能在中国发电量中所占份额日益增长，并且目前在新增装机容量中占据主导地位。随着电力系统向可再生能源发电转型，需要更大的灵活性来维持系统稳定。本文利用一个可计算一般均衡模型，评估这一转型的宏观经济影响。模型结果表明，近期电价将小幅上涨，随后随着可再生能源份额的提高而持续下降，尤其是当波动性通过储能电池而非燃煤备用发电来管理时。尽管这一转型需要对电力供应和投资进行大幅调整，但它从长期看会提高GDP，并增强能源安全。即便考虑到人工智能等新兴技术带来的电力需求增长，以电池为基础的灵活性方案在多个维度上仍优于继续依赖煤炭。然而，这一转型路径也增加了煤电行业资产搁浅的风险。

title: The Economic Implications of the Energy Transition in Asia-Pacific
abstract: This paper examines the economic effects of the global energy transition and the large uncertainty surrounding future fossil fuel demand on countries in the Asia-Pacific region. Under the paper’s baseline, coal demand is expected to shrink by 15 percent by 2035, although depending on global policy ambition and technological uptake, the decline could be as large as 45 percent. Model simulations indicate that one-third of global coal capital stock and one-quarter of Asia-Pacific coal capital stock could become stranded if the speed of the transition is underestimated. By contrast, global natural gas faces both upside and downside risks: when energy policy targets coal alone, natural gas extraction benefits, prompting an 18 percent rise in capital stock, whereas a fuel-agnostic transition would reduce gas capital stock by 16 percent. Impacts differ across countries, with high-cost coal exporters facing early losses, low-cost producers potentially gaining market share, and some gas exporters benefiting under select scenarios. At the same time, new growth opportunities will emerge for countries with strong critical mineral endowments and green energy potential.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了全球能源转型的经济效应，以及未来化石燃料需求的巨大不确定性对亚太地区各国的影响。在本文的基准情景下，到2035年煤炭需求预计将下降15%，但取决于全球政策力度和技术普及程度，降幅可能高达45%。模拟结果表明，如果低估了转型的速度，全球三分之一的煤炭资本存量和亚太地区四分之一的煤炭资本存量可能会搁浅。相比之下，全球天然气则同时面临上行和下行风险：当能源政策仅针对煤炭时，天然气开采受益，资本存量增加18%；而燃料中立的转型则会使天然气资本存量减少16%。各国受到的影响有所不同：高成本煤炭出口国面临早期损失，低成本生产国可能获得更多市场份额，而部分天然气出口国在某些情景下则会受益。与此同时，对于拥有丰富关键矿产资源和绿色能源潜力的国家而言，新的增长机会将会出现。

title: IMF-ENV: Integrating Climate, Energy, and Trade Policies in a General Equilibrium Framework
abstract: IMF-ENV is a global dynamic computable general equilibrium (CGE) model developed by the IMF's Research Department. The model features a database of 160 countries and regions, along with 76 sectors, and can be calibrated to a wide range of country-sector combinations. The model's general equilibrium structure, combined with its high level of detail, enables it to assess both direct and indirect domestic structural changes and cross-border spillover effects of policies. This makes it suitable for examining the medium- and long-term macroeconomic effects as well as structural shifts arising from national and/or global climate mitigation, energy, fiscal and trade policies. The model reports impact on macroeconomic variables, sectoral outcomes, employment and bilateral trade flows, along with detailed information for energy demand and supply, electricity generation and GHG emissions.
abstract_zh: IMF-ENV是由国际货币基金组织研究部开发的全球动态可计算一般均衡（CGE）模型。该模型包含160个国家和地区的数据库，以及76个部门，可以针对多种国家-部门组合进行校准。该模型的一般均衡结构与其高度细致的刻画相结合，使其能够评估政策的直接和间接国内结构变化以及跨境溢出效应。这使其适合于考察国家和/或全球气候减缓、能源、财政和贸易政策所产生的中长期宏观经济效应以及结构性转变。该模型报告了对宏观经济变量、部门结果、就业和双边贸易流量的影响，并提供能源需求与供应、电力生产和温室气体排放的详细信息。

title: The ocean carbon sink enhances countries’ inclusive wealth and reduces the cost of national climate policies
abstract: Improving our understanding of future ocean carbon uptake requires a nuanced understanding of the value of the annual ocean sink. Here, we combine an abatement cost-based approach and a climate damage-based approach to assess the value of the annual ocean sink. The former shows that the aggregate cost of national climate policies could increase by up to USD 80 billion if the ocean carbon sink weakens by 10 percent. As a complementary perspective, the damage-based approach shows that the annual ocean carbon sink contributes between USD 300 billion and USD 2,332 billion to countries’ inclusive wealth. Despite the conceptual appeal of the damage-based approach for its potential insights into regional wealth redistribution, uncertainties in national social cost of carbon estimates make it less reliable than the abatement cost-based approach, which in turn provides more reliable estimates for a fiscal cost assessment of improved monitoring services of the ocean carbon sink.
abstract_zh: 要增进我们对未来海洋碳吸收的理解，需要细致把握每年海洋碳汇的价值。在此，我们结合减排成本法和气候损害法来评估年度海洋碳汇的价值。前一种方法表明，如果海洋碳汇减弱10%，国家气候政策的总成本可能增加多达800亿美元。作为补充视角，损害法表明，年度海洋碳汇对各国包容性财富的贡献在3000亿美元至23320亿美元之间。尽管损害法在揭示区域财富再分配方面具有概念上的吸引力，但由于各国社会碳成本估计存在不确定性，其可靠性不及减排成本法；而减排成本法则能为改进海洋碳汇监测服务的财政成本评估提供更可靠的估计。

title: Cross-Border Impacts of Climate Policy Packages in North America
abstract: We quantify cross-border effects of the recent climate mitigation policies introduced in Canada and the U.S., using the global general equilibrium model IMF-ENV. Notably, with the substantial emission reductions from Canada’s carbon tax-led mitigation policies and the U.S.’ Inflation Reduction Act, these two countries would bridge two-thirds of the gap toward their Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC) goals. While the broadly divergent policies are believed to elicit competitiveness concerns, we find the aggregate cross-border effects within North America to be very limited and restricted to the energy intensive and trade exposed industries. Potential carbon leakages are also found to be negligible. A more meaningful difference triggered by policy heterogeneity is rather domestic, especially with U.S. subsidies increasing energy output while the Canada model with a carbon tax would marginally decrease it. This analysis is complemented by a stylized model illustrating how such divergence can affect the terms of trade, but also how these effects can be countered by exchange rate flexibility, border adjustments or domestic taxation.
abstract_zh: 我们使用全球一般均衡模型IMF-ENV，量化了加拿大和美国近期推出的气候减缓政策的跨境效应。值得注意的是，凭借加拿大以碳税为主导的减排政策以及美国《通胀削减法案》（Inflation Reduction Act）带来的大幅减排，这两个国家将弥合其国家自主贡献（NDC）目标缺口的三分之二。尽管政策差异较大，人们认为可能引发竞争力方面的担忧，但我们发现北美内部的总体跨境效应非常有限，且仅限于能源密集型和贸易暴露型行业。潜在的碳泄漏也被发现微不足道。政策异质性所引发的更有意义的差异实际上是国内层面的，尤其是美国的补贴增加了能源产出，而加拿大实行碳税的模式则会使能源产出略有下降。本分析还辅以一个程式化模型，说明这种分化如何影响贸易条件，以及汇率弹性、边境调节或国内税收如何抵消这些效应。

title: A Dynamic Baseline Calibration Procedure for CGE Models
A Framework for Climate Change Mitigation in India
abstract: Climate change poses challenging policy tradeoffs for India. The country faces the challenge of raising living standards for a population of 1.4 billion while at the same time needing to be a critical contributor to reducing global GHG emissions. The government has implemented numerous policies to promote the manufacturing and use of renewable energy and shift away from coal, but much still needs to be done to reach India’s 2070 net zero goal. Reducing GHG emissions will almost certainly have a negative impact on growth in the short run and have important distributional consequences for individuals and communities who today rely on coal. But with the right policies, these costs—which are non-negligible but dwarfed by the cost of climate change over the next decade if no action is taken—can be significantly curtailed. This paper provides an in depth review of the current climate policy landscape in India and models emissions trajectories under different policy options to reduce GHG emissions.
abstract_zh: 气候变化给印度带来了棘手的政策权衡。该国面临的挑战是，既要为14亿人口提高生活水平，又要成为减少全球温室气体排放的关键贡献者。政府已实施了大量政策以促进可再生能源的制造和使用，并推动摆脱煤炭，但要实现印度2070年净零排放的目标，仍有许多工作需要完成。减少温室气体排放几乎肯定会在短期内对增长产生负面影响，并对当今依赖煤炭的个人和社区产生重要的分配后果。但是，只要政策得当，这些成本——虽然不可忽视，但若不采取行动，与未来十年气候变化的代价相比则微不足道——可以得到显著压缩。本文深入回顾了印度当前的气候政策格局，并模拟了不同政策选项下减少温室气体排放的排放路径。

title: Economic Gains from Global Cooperation in Fulfilling Climate Pledges
abstract: Mitigation of CO2 emissions is a global public good that imposes different regional economic costs. We assess the distributional effects of cooperative versus non-cooperative CO2 markets to fulfil the Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs), considering different CO2 permit allocation rules in cooperative markets. We employ a global computable general equilibrium model based on the GTAP-9 database and the add-on GTAP-Power database. Our results show the resulting winners and losers under different policy scenarios with different permit allocation rules. We see that in 2030, we can obtain gains as high as $106 billion from global cooperation in CO2 markets. A cooperative CO2 permit market with equal per capita allowances results in considerable monetary transfers from high per capita emission regions to low per capita emission regions. In per capita terms, these transfers are comparable to the Official Development Assistance (ODA) transfers. We also disaggregate the mitigation costs into direct and indirect shares. For the energy-exporting regions, the largest cost component is unambiguously the indirect mitigation costs.
abstract_zh: 二氧化碳减排是一项全球公共物品，但不同地区承担的经济成本各不相同。我们评估了合作型与非合作型二氧化碳市场在履行国家自主贡献（NDC）方面的分配效应，并考虑了合作市场中不同的碳排放许可分配规则。我们采用了基于GTAP-9数据库及其附加模块GTAP-Power数据库的全球可计算一般均衡模型。结果显示，在不同政策情景和不同许可分配规则下，赢家和输家各不相同。我们发现，到2030年，全球在二氧化碳市场上的合作可带来高达1060亿美元的收益。采用人均等额配额的合作型碳排放许可市场，将导致大量货币从人均排放较高的地区转移至人均排放较低的地区。按人均计算，这些转移支付与官方发展援助（ODA）规模相当。我们还将减排成本分解为直接成本和间接成本。对于能源出口地区而言，最大的成本构成无疑是间接减排成本。

title: Gains Associated with Linking the EU and Chinese ETS under Different Assumptions on Restrictions, Allowance Endowments, and International Trade
The economic and environment benefits from international co-ordination on carbon pricing: a review of economic modelling studies <sup>*</sup>
abstract: This paper reviews quantitative estimates of the economic and environmental benefits from different forms of international co-ordination on carbon pricing based on economic modelling studies. Forms of international co-ordination include: harmonising carbon prices (e.g. through linking carbon markets), extending the coverage of pricing schemes, phasing out fossil fuel subsidies, developing international sectoral agreements, and establishing co-ordination mechanisms to mitigate carbon leakage. All forms of international co-operation on carbon pricing could deliver benefits, both economic (e.g. lower mitigation costs) and environmental (e.g. reducing greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions and carbon leakage). There is scope to considerably increase the coverage of carbon pricing, since until 2021 only around 40% of energy-related CO 2 emissions in 44 OECD and G20 countries face a carbon price. There is also significant scope to improve international co-ordination on carbon pricing: moving from unilateral carbon prices to a globally harmonized carbon price to reach the 1st round of NDC targets for 2030 can reduce global mitigation cost on average by two thirds or $229 billion. Benefits tend to be higher with broader participation of countries, broader coverage of emissions and sectors and, more ambitious policy goals. Extending carbon pricing to non-CO 2 GHG could reduce global mitigation costs by up to 48%. Absolute cost savings from harmonized carbon prices increase by almost 70% in 2030 for reductions in line with the 2 °C target. Most, but not all, countries gain economic benefits from international co-operation, and these benefits vary significantly across countries and regions. Complementary measures outside co-operation on carbon pricing (e.g. technology transfers) could potentially ensure that co-operation provides economic benefits for all countries.
abstract_zh: 本文基于经济建模研究，回顾了关于不同形式的碳定价国际协调所带来的经济和环境效益的定量估计。国际协调的形式包括：协调碳价格（例如通过碳市场挂钩）、扩大定价机制的覆盖范围、逐步取消化石燃料补贴、制定国际行业协议，以及建立协调机制以减轻碳泄漏。碳定价方面的所有国际合作形式都可能带来效益，既包括经济效益（例如降低减排成本），也包括环境效益（例如减少温室气体排放和碳泄漏）。碳定价的覆盖范围仍有很大的扩展空间，因为截至2021年，44个经合组织和二十国集团国家中，只有约40%的能源相关二氧化碳排放面临碳价格。在碳定价的国际协调方面也存在显著的改进空间：从单边碳价格转向全球统一的碳价格，以实现2030年第一轮国家自主贡献目标，平均可以将全球减排成本降低三分之二，即2290亿美元。当参与国家更广泛、排放和行业覆盖范围更广、政策目标更雄心勃勃时，效益往往更高。将碳定价扩展到非二氧化碳温室气体，可使全球减排成本最多降低48%。对于符合2摄氏度目标的减排量，到2030年，统一碳价格带来的绝对成本节约将增加近70%。大多数（但并非全部）国家都能从国际合作中获得经济效益，而且这些效益在不同国家和地区之间差异显著。在碳定价合作之外的互补性措施（例如技术转让）有可能确保合作为所有国家带来经济效益。
